newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Australian paedophile suspect denied S.African bail.
newsitem.headline: Australian paedophile suspect denied S.African bail.

text.p: An Australian paedophile suspect, arrested in South Africa last week after a worldwide police hunt, was denied bail on Monday and told to return to court next month for an extradition hearing.

State radio said the court in Humansdorp, near the surfing mecca of Jeffreys Bay where Phillip Bell was caught, rejected his bail application after hearing he had been charged at home with 215 sex offences relating to boys aged 10 to 18.
Bell, who said he wanted bail in order to return to Australia and clear his name, was told to return to the magistrate's court on February 4 for his extradition hearing.

Australia sent a police officer from its child protection task force to South Africa to make a formal plea for extradition of the wealthy 62-year-old businessman who was apparently trying to settle down in the coastal resort.
The court heard Bell was rich enough and well enough connected round the world to stand a good chance of fleeing if granted bail.
